subject: Durable materials for everyday kitchens
hook: Quality-checked before it leaves: what that looks like.
ig:
Quality-checked before it leaves: what that looks like for a kitchen cabinet.

It's a line you'll see on a lot of websites, including ours. So here's what it means in our Hanley workshop.

— Edges: every exposed edge is ABS-sealed and checked by hand
— Square: carcasses are checked corner to corner, because a cabinet that's out of square makes doors sit crooked
— Hardware: soft-close drawers and hinges are tested before the doors go on for good
— Packing: wrapped and labelled, so it arrives in the condition it left

Durability isn't only about the board. It's about how carefully each cabinet is put together and checked. And because our own team fits it, the same people who built it are there when it goes in.

Planning a kitchen? Comment BUILT and we'll send you the link to our bespoke kitchens page.
fb:
"Quality-checked" can mean anything, so we thought we'd show you what it means here.

This reel follows a kitchen cabinet through the last stages in our Hanley workshop: edges checked, carcass squared up, soft-close hardware tested, doors adjusted, then wrapped and labelled for delivery. Our own team then installs it.

It's not glamorous, but it's why a kitchen still feels solid years later. Have a look at our bespoke kitchens if you're planning one.
